title: A chart is laid out in a conversation between the page and the engine

messages.label: fence closed: source
messages.what: Promotes a closed tugchart fence to a figure; an open one stays code.

messages.label: validate(source)
messages.what: Checks the spec; an invalid one shows its errors in place.

messages.label: wait for each role's face
messages.what: Waits for the faces the roles are set in, with a three-second horizon.

messages.label: compile_round(source, { })
messages.what: Runs one round of layout against the table of measurements so far.

messages.label: measure each pair
messages.what: Measures exactly the pairs asked for, in the role's own computed font.

messages.label: replace the source with the figure
messages.what: Builds the figure off-document and swaps it in with one write.
